units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 1. Transfer of a civil servant to another civil service position in the same state body, including in another locality, or to another civil service position in another state body in the cases established by this Federal Law is permitted:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 1) on the initiative of the employer's representative, with the civil servant's written consent, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2) on the civil servant's initiative, by decision of the employer's representative.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2. Transfer to another civil service position in another state body on the civil servant's initiative is effected by agreement between the employer's representatives of the current and receiving state bodies, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law, and on the basis of the civil servant's written application sent to the employer's representative of the current state body at least two weeks before transfer.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 3. By agreement between the employer's representative of the state body with which the service contract has been concluded and the employer's representative of the state body with which a contract is planned, and with the civil servant's consent, the civil servant may be released from the current position and transferred to another position in the other state body before the date specified in the civil servant's written application.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 4. When a service contract is terminated because of transfer to another civil service position in another state body, the civil servant's personnel file is transferred in the prescribed manner to the receiving state body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 5. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body takes place:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 1) on the basis of a competition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2) on appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1–3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 22 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 3) because the civil servant is unable, for health reasons confirmed by a medical opinion, to perform the duties of the position held;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 4) because a civil servant who previously held the position is reinstated by court decision;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 5) by decision of the employer's representative because the civil servant's access to state secrets necessary for official duties has been terminated or refused on the ground that close relatives specified in Article 21 of Law of the Russian Federation No. 5485-I of 21 July 1993 ‘On State Secrets’ permanently reside abroad and/or hold foreign citizenship (nationality) or a residence permit or other document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign State, as provided for by the fourth paragraph of part one of Article 22 of that Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 6) upon reduction of the position held by the civil servant in accordance with Article 31 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 6 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 7) in connection with rotation under Article 60.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 8) in connection with demotion in the civil service and exclusion from the personnel reserve, if included in it, following attestation under point 3 of part 16 of Article 48 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 8 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 9) to eliminate direct subordination or accountability between civil servants who are close blood relatives or relatives by marriage, in order to comply with the restriction in point 5 of part 1 of Article 16 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 10) where a civil servant needs temporarily to fill another position under Article 30 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 11) upon refusal of a position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 11 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 12) where the civil servant does not agree to continue holding the position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract under Article 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 12 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 13) upon expiry of the prescribed term of office of a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ or ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, in the case provided for by part 4 of Article 35 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 13 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 14) where a civil servant holds foreign citizenship (nationality) that has not been terminated for reasons beyond their control, in exceptional cases and in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation, provided that the other position does not require clearance for access to state secrets, taking account of Article 26 of Federal Law No. 116-ФЗ of 30 April 2021 ‘On Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 14 Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 6. Transfer to another civil service position in another state body takes place:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 1) on the basis of a competition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2) on appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1–3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 22 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 3) upon reduction of a civil service position or abolition of a state body under Article 31 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 4) in connection with rotation under Article 60.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 5) upon refusal of a position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 7. Transfer to another civil service position in the cases provided for by this Article requires the civil servant to meet the qualification requirements for that other position.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 8. Transfer with demotion in the cases provided for by points 3–5, 9 and 12–14 of part 5 of this Article is permitted only if transfer is impossible to a civil service position in the same category and group as the current position, with an official salary no lower than that of the current position.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 9. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body under this Article is formalized by a legal act of the state body and accompanied by amendment of the service contract through a supplementary agreement.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 10. If transfer to another civil service position under points 3–5, 8, 9 and 12–14 of part 5 of this Article is impossible because no such position exists, or if the civil servant refuses transfer under this Article, the civil servant is subject to dismissal from the civil service unless otherwise provided by federal laws. In these cases the service contract is terminated, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed under point 8 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law, unless another ground for dismissal is expressly established by this Federal Law; by decision of the employer's representative and with the civil servant's consent, the civil servant is included in the personnel reserve (except the federal civil service personnel reserve), except in the case provided for by point 8 of part 5 of this Article.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 11. Reassignment to another structural subdivision of the same state body in the same locality is not a transfer to another civil service position and does not require the civil servant's consent if it does not change the terms of the service contract, except the term concerning the place of civil service.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 12. Before the service contract is terminated in connection with transfer to another state body, the civil servant may withdraw their application or consent at any time.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 13. A civil servant who is subject to an internal service inquiry or a check of compliance with restrictions, prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and performance of duties established to combat corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws may not be transferred to another position in the same state body or to another state body. The exception is transfer, in the cases specified in points 3–6, 9, 10, 13 and 14 of part 5 of this Article, to a position in the same state body with an official salary not exceeding that of the position currently held.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 1. If changes in a civil servant's professional service conditions make it impossible to retain the service contract terms, those terms may be changed on the employer's representative's initiative, with the civil servant's written consent, without changing the civil servant's official duties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 2. Reasons for changes in professional service conditions entailing changes to service contract terms without changes to official duties include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 1) inclusion of the position held in the list of civil service positions subject to rotation, or removal of the position from that list;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 2) relocation to another locality of the state body or its structural subdivision in which the civil servant holds a position;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 3) changes to remuneration terms in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 4) changes to the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 5) changes to the service contract terms provided for by point 7 of part 2 of Article 24 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 3. The employer's representative must notify the civil servant in writing of forthcoming changes to the service contract terms and the reasons for them at least two months before they take effect, except for the changes provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 4. If a civil servant does not agree to continue state service relations in the current position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract, other than the changes in points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, and the state body has other vacant civil service positions retaining those professional service conditions, the employer's representative must offer those vacancies in writing against acknowledgement of receipt, taking account of the category and group of the current position, provided that the civil servant meets the qualification requirements for the position.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 5. If a civil servant refuses in writing to continue state service relations in the current position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract terms specified in points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, the service contract is terminated under point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Changes to service contract terms due to changes in professional service conditions
units.text: 6. If the civil servant refuses in writing another civil service position offered because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract, or if no such position exists in the same state body, the service contract is terminated under point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: 1. In the event of service necessity, the employer's representative may transfer a civil servant for up to one month to a civil service position in the same state body not specified in the service contract, with remuneration for the temporary position but not below the previously established remuneration. Such transfer is permitted to prevent a catastrophe or industrial accident, remedy the consequences of a catastrophe, industrial accident or natural disaster, prevent accidents, temporary suspension of professional service activity for economic, technological, technical or organizational reasons, or destruction of or damage to property, and to replace a temporarily absent civil servant. The civil servant may not be transferred to another position contraindicated for health reasons.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: 2. Transfer to replace a temporarily absent civil servant may not exceed one month in a calendar year.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Temporary filling of another civil service position
units.text: 3. By agreement of the parties to the service contract, the employer's representative may appoint the civil servant to a position not specified in that contract which was previously held by a temporarily absent civil servant, including a position in a higher group, setting the official salary for the temporary position but no lower than that of the previous position, paying the supplements established for the temporary position and providing state social guarantees.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.label: Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 1. Upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, state service relations continue if the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the body being abolished is offered, with their written consent, another civil service position in the same state body, in the state body receiving the abolished body's functions, or in another state body, taking account of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 1) the civil servant's professional level, specialty, field of training and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 2) the level of professional education and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training, provided that the civil servant receives additional professional education corresponding to the field and type of professional service activity of the position offered.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in a state body being abolished is personally notified by the employer's representative, against acknowledgement of receipt, of the forthcoming dismissal due to reduction of positions or abolition of the body at least two months before dismissal.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 3. During the period specified in part 2 of this Article, the state body may conduct an extraordinary attestation of civil servants under Article 48 of this Federal Law. On its results, civil servants with a preferential right to hold a civil service position may be offered other civil service positions, including in another state body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 4. A preferential right to hold a civil service position is given to a civil servant with a higher professional level, a specialty and field of training corresponding to the field and type of their professional service activity, longer civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training, and better results of professional service activity.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 5. Within two months after notifying a civil servant of dismissal, the employer's representative of the state body reducing civil service positions, or of the state body receiving the functions of an abolished body, must offer the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the abolished body all vacant civil service positions available in the same body or the body receiving those functions, respectively, taking account of the category and group of the current position, the civil servant's professional level, specialty, field of training, and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training. If no such positions exist in those bodies, the representative may offer vacancies in other state bodies in the manner determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 6. If a civil servant refuses another civil service position offered, including in another state body, upon reduction of positions or abolition of a state body, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service. The service contract is then terminated under point 8.2 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law for reduction of positions, or under point 8.3 of part 1 of Article 37 for abolition of a state body.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Civil service relations upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body
units.text: 7. With the civil servant's written consent, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the period specified in part 2 of this Article expires, paying additional compensation equal to retained monetary remuneration calculated proportionately to the time remaining until expiry of the dismissal notice period.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 1. The employer's representative must suspend from the civil service position held (not permit to perform official duties) a civil servant:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 1) who reports for service under the influence of alcohol, narcotic drugs or other toxic substances;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Suspension from the civil service position held
units.text: 2) who has not undergone the prescribed training and assessment of knowledge and skills in protection of professional service activity (occupational safety);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 32
